# Kaggle LLM Agentic Legal IR 2026

Repository: https://github.com/wara886/kaggle_llm_agentic_legal_ir_2026

Purpose: legal citation retrieval for a Kaggle Swiss legal IR competition. The system maps case queries to relevant legal citations using hybrid retrieval, reranking, citation parsing, law-family auditing, and targeted low-spillover corrections.

Current best:
- Public score: 0.25015
- Best submission: release/submission_surface_anchor_escape_combo_v20_test015_mandate_partnership_maintenance_tight_local/submission.csv
- Note: v21-v25 were boundary checks and did not replace v20 tight.

Read first:
- README.md
- docs/project_core_manifest.md
- docs/current_progress_summary.md
- docs/experiment_log.md
- docs/next_optimization_handoff.md
- docs/kaggle_legal_ir_project_resume_review_v2_cn.md

Main execution:
- scripts/run_silver_baseline_v0.py
- scripts/run_qwen3_reranker_module_ablation.py
- scripts/run_targeted_test_patch.py
- scripts/run_surface_family_audit.py
- scripts/evaluate_submission_official_strict.py

Core modules:
- src/legal_ir/corpus_builder.py
- src/legal_ir/data_loader.py
- src/retrieval_sparse.py
- src/retrieval_dense.py
- src/retrieval_rules.py
- src/fusion.py
- src/rerank.py
- src/law_family.py
- src/query_family.py
- src/citation_normalizer.py
- src/legal_ir/normalization.py

Data boundary:
- data_raw/, artifacts/, outputs/, and logs/ are local-only and intentionally ignored.
- The public repository contains code, docs, and selected submission CSVs, not Kaggle raw data.
